snippet.title: Tappy Chicken for iOS, Android & HTML5 | Project Spotlight | Unreal Engine
snippet.description: Tappy Chicken is a lightweight, cross-platform app built with Unreal Engine 4 by one artist in one weekend. No coding! Get started at www.unrealengine.com.
